systems.name: 12.1 Discovery‑Based Unlocks
systems.notes: World starts simple. As players reach depths, defeat bosses, or assemble key fragments, new content unlocks globally — new structures, harder enemies, advanced ores.
tasks: Define unlock milestones (depth reached, bosses killed, items crafted)
Implement milestone check on chunk generation
Add new structures, enemies, and resources per milestone
Ensure seamless transition (no reload needed)

systems.name: 12.2 World State Machine
systems.notes: Track global milestones: first sky-castle, first titan, first dreadnaught, Sun Engine active. Each triggers world-wide changes: NPCs, hazards, generation for future chunks.
tasks: Implement world state data structure (shared across players)
Define state transitions and effects
Update world generation functions to read state
Notify players of world changes via UI and dialogue

systems.name: 12.3 Backward Compatibility & Opt‑Out
systems.notes: Players who prefer a simpler experience can ignore quests and the ancient path; the world won't force complexity. The core mining loop remains intact. Old saves update seamlessly when players pursue new triggers.
tasks: Ensure base game loop works unchanged
Allow players to disable escalation (creative/peaceful mode)
Test save migration from v1 to v2 world states
Add UI toggle for progression pace

systems.name: 12.4 Castle Expansion & Desert Structures
systems.notes: Large fortified ruins in plains/forest, step pyramids in deserts with traps and treasure. Uses world state milestones for generation.
tasks: Design castle generation: large fortified ruins in plains/forest biomes, includes towers, courtyards, and underground vaults; uses world state milestones
Desert pyramids: step pyramids with traps and treasure rooms, inspired by ancient goblin architecture; hazard triggers from Phase 2
Add new decorative blocks: castle walls, pillars, archways; use existing model loading (Phase 1.3) for custom assets
Ensure structures generate only after certain milestones; tie to discovery-based unlocks (Phase 12)

systems.name: 12.5 Per Biome Trees & Flora
systems.notes: Tree types per biome (pine, palm, jungle, etc.), grass and flowers as decorative sprites. World-generation only, no collision.
tasks: Define tree types per biome: pine, palm, jungle, dead, etc.; variation in shape, color, and leaf density; spawn on world gen
Grass & flowers: scatter small decorative sprites; use billboard sprites for performance; sync only world-gen data
Seasonal variation or colour shifts based on world state; optional: tie to Sun Engine activation or biome corruption
Ensure flora does not block building or pathfinding; replaceable on block placement; no collision for grass/flowers

systems.name: 12.6 Biome Blend & Terrain Polish
systems.notes: Smooth biome transitions with blended block edges, biome-specific detail layers (pebbles, roots, crystals), improved river and cliff generation.
tasks: Smooth biome transitions with blended block edges; use noise-based interpolation for grass/stone/soil colours
Add biome-specific detail layers (pebbles, roots, crystals); decals or small entities; purely visual
Improve river and cliff generation for natural look; adjust terrain heightmap and water placement
Optimise performance with LODs for distant biomes; use existing chunk LOD system
